scenario: `cached(key)` is the only read function ([LGRA.9.8.2]), so a `let` RHS naming any other read function is refused by the closed built-in set ([LGRA.9.8.11]) with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_FUNCTION. Drives the built-in-name resolution path in the validator, not the schema-resolution path: the argument names a declared schema, so a reject on schema grounds would mean the case never reached the check it is named for. Pin: `let r = latest(Event)` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_FUNCTION.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Event
->
    let r = latest(Event)
    log info "ok"
